notes.title: Japanese and English Version Update
notes.notes:
This time, Japanese and English have been installed.
Players can switch between Japanese and English by right-clicking the game name in the library and selecting Properties - Language - Japanese/English.
Attention!
1. Only the subtitles have been changed.
2. Bilingual versions may have bugs that do not affect the game experience.
3. Switching to the bilingual version requires a version update.

Here is a special note
Thanks to Yuhan for the Japanese translation.
Thanks to shotomato-sensei for the English translation.
Thank you very much!


Lastly, thank you all.
